content: Filament (google/filament): Apache License 2.0 (direct LICENSE fetch confirmed). Backends: OpenGL ES 3.0+/GL, Metal, Vulkan 1.0 (now supported on Linux/macOS/Windows in addition to Android), WebGPU, WebGL2. GitHub issue #2007 ('Request for headless swapChain support with Vulkan') is now CLOSED -- headless swapchain support for Vulkan has landed since the prior research session flagged it as an open request, meaning Filament's headless-Vulkan story has matured. Still an engine-shaped abstraction (PBR materials, matc shader compiler, asset pipeline) rather than a thin schema-driven pipeline builder.
